title: Reusable audited ticket redaction and comment revision operations
objective: After Phase 1 is merged, design and implement reusable MCP operations for owner-authorized redaction of sensitive ticket content with private evidence retention, and revision-history-preserving edits to existing comments. This work is explicitly deferred until after the Phase 1 merge and is not a dependency or blocker for M1a, M1b, M2, M3, M4, or final acceptance.

acceptance_criteria.text: A supported MCP redaction operation can target ticket cases, comments, and other explicitly approved content fields; it retains original evidence only in an owner-controlled private location and preserves verifiable audit integrity without silently rewriting existing audit history.

A supported MCP comment-edit operation requires appropriate authorization and preserves prior comment revisions in an auditable history; it never silently overwrites historical discussion or test evidence.

The reusable operations have documented authorization, retry, failure, and privacy behavior, with tests covering audit preservation, private retention, revision history, and prevention of sensitive-content leakage.
The completed ticket-engine capabilities are validated through MCP and do not reopen, redesign, or alter the completed ticket #54 correction.

needed: Design and security review of reusable MCP redaction and comment revision authorization, audit, and private-retention semantics.
Engine/MCP tests for redaction and comment revision history, retries, audit validation, private permissions, and sensitive-content leakage.
